values.task_boundary: Exactly one accepted access-and-billing baseline; individual readbacks are evidence inputs and do not close independently.
deliverables: Human, workload, and agent-initiated identity census
Agent Toolkit for AWS approved Codex path and AWS CLI version check
Agent IAM guardrail and read-only default posture specification
Billing, budget, anomaly, export, and cost-attribution readbacks
Credential redaction and no-mutation validation proof
Fresh exact-head review and closing PR
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Corporate recovery does not depend on one personal factor.
AC-2: Human workload and agent-initiated identities are distinguishable.
AC-3: Agent Toolkit for AWS is configured for the approved Codex path with AWS CLI 2.35 or newer.
AC-4: IAM context policies bind agent actions with read-only default posture.
AC-5: CloudWatch metrics and CloudTrail requests are attributable.
AC-6: Billing and budget ownership is visible.
AC-7: Existing administrator access remains until replacement is proven.
AC-8: Evidence contains no credentials, secrets, raw token contents, or unintended mutation commands.
AC-9: Fresh exact-head review has zero actionable findings and publication truth closes only issue #485.
